_note: Regular Vassals set up on the map at their Seat with a Calendar marker (Service). Loyalty is added to a same-color Levying Lord's Influence and subtracted for opposite color; null = no Loyalty rating. Special Vassals are Mustered via a Capability card, have no Seat/Loyalty/Service, do not appear on the Calendar, and need not be Paid; full effects are implemented in Phase 4.

hastings.name: Hastings
hastings.effect: Levied free; adds 2 Men-at-Arms units and Command +1 to Edward IV. Command +1 ends if Hastings Disbands. The 2 Men-at-Arms are not affected by Hastings Disbanding, but per FAQ #6 they ARE removed during Waste.

edward_prince_of_wales.name: Edward (Prince of Wales)
edward_prince_of_wales.effect: Levied free; grants Valour +1 to Margaret.

montagu.name: Montagu
montagu.effect: Levied free; gives Warwick's Retinue Armour 1-5, including for the rest of any Battle in which Montagu Routs.

clifford.name: Clifford
clifford.effect: Levied free; grants Valour +1 to the Lord. (Capability L21 'My Father's Blood'.)

thomas_stanley.name: Stanley
thomas_stanley.effect: Levied free; once per Levy, the Lord can Levy Troops for 0 Lordship while retaining the Capability and Special Vassal. (Capability L35 'Thomas Stanley'.)

trollope.name: Trollope
trollope.effect: Levied free; grants Valour +1 to the Lord. (Capability L19 'Andrew Trollope'.)
